[LEXP.5.7.1] Overloaded by arity; returns **distance**, not similarity
(matching `scipy.spatial.distance.cosine`). Range `[0, 2]`.
Authors who want similarity subtract it from `1`.

| Function | Arity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `cosine(ax, ay, bx, by)` | 2D | `1 - cos(θ)` between 2D vectors |
| `cosine(ax, ay, az, bx, by, bz)` | 3D | `1 - cos(θ)` between 3D vectors |
